verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents secure vault sharing and member access and permission management for shared vaults and items, and it stores and generates TOTP codes for saved logins. These pieces together imply TOTP-protected logins can be shared with per-member control, but no source explicitly confirms that TOTP secrets carry over to shared items or describes team or admin role granularity. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that TOTP fields are shared via vaults, documentation of permission roles and levels, admin-console or team-policy controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control

citations.quote: Manage member access and permissions to shared vaults and items
Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
